items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网·鲸犀获悉，AI母婴智能硬件品牌珂迪 Coddie （以下简称“ Coddie ”）完成天使轮融资，融资金额数千万元，由钟鼎资本投资，向阳资本担任独家财务顾问。 Coddie 团队于 2026 年初组建，由 95 后连续创业者何鋡威创立。何鋡威毕业于德国慕尼黑工业大学，先后任职华为、传音控股、拓竹科技等全球头部科技企业，积累了横跨全球 40 余个国家本地化的实战经验。 Coddie 创始人何鋡威认为，参考以往新技术发展的规律：AI硬件的爆发不能停留在提供情绪价值的“痒点”或“爽点”，必须直击极具付费意愿的“痛点”，即缓解新手父母因经验不足带来的育儿焦虑与高强度的体力消耗 。 当前全球母婴家庭面临养育压力大、成本高、信息繁杂等核心痛点，而传统母婴产品仍停留在基础功能阶段，智能化程度不足、生态割裂，无法满足新一代家庭需求。事实上，母婴智能设备在全球已发展多年，智能喂养、发育监测和孕产科技也成为全球增速较快的核心品类。 何鋡威告诉鲸犀：“我们觉得AI 来了，很多行业都要重做。育儿赛道过去拼营销、拼渠道，未来一定拼产品、拼智能。我们就想干一件事：基于AI 决策 + 硬件执行的逻辑，把未来育儿方式变成今天能用的产品。 可以理解为在具身智能不够成熟进入家庭照顾孩子之前，更务实的做法是将机器人“打散”，变成基于AI驱动一个个解决具体场景问题的智能硬件。” 市场布局上，Coddie 前期优先深耕欧美市场。本质是抓两大核心红利：一是欧美高端育儿产品的付费心智成熟；二是人力成本极高且专业育儿资源稀缺—— 美国专业育儿保姆月薪高达 1–2 万美金，这为智能硬件的“机器代人”提供了天然的替代刚需。北美每年海量新生儿叠加双职工家庭结构，撑起了高溢价、高确定性的育儿智能硬件赛道。 创业者对谈 鲸犀：从解放父母到托管式育儿，Coddie 的 AI 硬件生态究竟想重构什么？ 何鋡威： 在产品规划上，

excerpt_i18n.en: Leiphone.com · Jingxi reports that AI maternal and infant smart hardware brand Coddie has completed its angel round of financing, raising tens of millions of yuan, invested by Zhongding Capital, with Xiangyang Capital serving as the exclusive financial advisor. The Coddie team was formed in early 2026, founded by He Hanwei, a serial entrepreneur born after 1995. He Hanwei graduated from the Technical University of Munich and has worked at global leading tech companies such as Huawei, Transsion Holdings, and Bambu Lab, accumulating hands-on experience across over 40 countries. Coddie founder He Hanwei believes that, following the pattern of past technological developments, the explosion of AI hardware cannot stop at providing emotional value as a "nice-to-have" or "pleasure point"; it must directly address "pain points" that drive willingness to pay, such as alleviating parenting anxiety and high physical exertion for new parents due to lack of experience. Currently, global maternal and infant families face core pain points like high parenting pressure, high costs, and complex information, while traditional maternal and infant products remain at a basic functional stage, lacking intelligence and fragmented in ecosystem, unable to meet the needs of new-generation families. In fact, smart maternal and infant devices have been developing globally for years, with smart feeding, developmental monitoring, and pregnancy technology becoming fast-growing core categories worldwide. He Hanwei told Jingxi: "We believe that with AI, many industries need to be reinvented. In the parenting track, the past focused on marketing and channels, but the future will be about products and intelligence. We just want to do one thing: based on the logic of AI decision-making plus hardware execution, to shape the future."

items.title: 百亿估值背后，普渡机器人以全球化商业实战练就具身智能「最强大脑」
items.raw_excerpt: 上个月刚刚完成近10亿元新一轮融资、跻身 百亿估值独角兽俱乐部 的普渡机器人，日前重磅发布两大核心技术：具身智能基座大模型PuduFM 1.0和通用具身智能体平台PuduAgent。 两项技术发布，直指普渡深耕已久的顶层具身技术战略 —— “一脑多形” 。 这是引领具身智能行业的里程碑式技术布局。过去数年，机器人行业风口轮动，人形、四足、机械臂、大模型等软硬件技术层出不穷，但赛道却始终面临一个终极命题：如何从炫技的样机，变成规模化、可持续进化的商业生产力？ 依托前瞻布局与实战沉淀，普渡给出了答案：不赌单一终极形态，而是坚定布局 全场景、多形态协同 的具身智能路径，扎根真实商业场景，让具身智能从实验室Demo走向规模化商用，成为可量产、可协同、可持续进化的全球产品网络，引领具身智能的商业化发展方向。 支撑这一前瞻技术布局的，是普渡十年积累的硬核规模化商用落地能力：全球落地超 13万台机器人 、出海营收连续多年占比超8成、业务覆盖 80余个国家和地区 ，深度扎根餐饮、酒店、零售、医疗、工业等千行百业的不同场景；从配送、清洁，到工业与通用具身的前沿布局，普渡已构建起全品类产品矩阵。其中 商用清洁营收占比超 70% ，工业AMR上市一年出货突破 4000 台 ，稳居行业第一梯队。 如今的普渡，已凭借全球领先的商用落地规模，成为具身智能商业化标杆，更以全场景布局直面具身智能下半场核心方向：让十余万形态各异的机器人遍布物理世界，在统一大脑体系下高效协同、持续进化。 PuduFM 1.0 与 PuduAgent 的发布，正是普渡给出的行业最优解。前者让机器人真正理解物理世界、预判物理因果；后者实现能力调度、任务协同、经验复用，二者支撑起“一脑多形” 的战略落地，成为普渡向多品类、全场景 具身智能平台型企业 跨越的关键里程碑，引领行业全新发展阶段。 01普渡为什么要做机器人的 AI“大脑”

These two technology releases directly target Pudu's long-established top-level embodied intelligence strategy—"One Brain, Multiple Forms." Over the past few years, the robotics industry has seen shifting trends, with various software and hardware technologies such as humanoid robots, quadruped robots, robotic arms, and large models emerging one after another. excerpt_i18n.es: El mes pasado, el robot Pudu completó una nueva ronda de financiación de casi 1.000 millones de yuanes, uniéndose al club de unicornios valorados en más de 10.000 millones. Recientemente, lanzó dos tecnologías clave: el modelo base de inteligencia encarnada PuduFM 1.0 y la plataforma de agentes inteligentes encarnados PuduAgent. Ambos avances apuntan directamente a la estrategia tecnológica de alto nivel que Pudu ha desarrollado durante años: "un cerebro, múltiples formas". Se trata de un hito tecnológico que marca el rumbo en la industria de la inteligencia encarnada. En los últimos años, las tendencias en robótica han cambiado constantemente, con tecnologías de hardware y software como humanoides, cuadrúpedos, brazos robóticos y grandes modelos surgiendo sin cesar. Sin embargo, el sector siempre se ha enfrentado a una pregunta fundamental: cómo pasar de prototipos llamativos a una producción escalable y sostenible.

title_i18n.es: La cortesía en las indicaciones afecta la precisión de los LLM (2025)

excerpt_i18n.en: A 2025 study reveals that the politeness level of prompts affects LLM accuracy, with overly polite or rude prompts reducing performance while neutral prompts yield better results.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项2025年的研究表明，向大型语言模型（LLM）提问时的礼貌程度会影响其回答的准确性。研究发现，过于礼貌或过于粗鲁的提示词都可能导致模型表现下降，而中性或适度礼貌的提示词通常能获得更准确的结果。

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网讯 AI 时代企业增长新逻辑 2026 年 5 月 22 日，新一期北纬诺贝巅峰对话在北京中关村学院 x 中关村人工智能研究院（简称“中关村两院”）隆重举行，本次活动由中关村两院及北纬港湾共同举办。全球知名 AI 战略专家、美国未来产业研究院创始人乔·韦曼（ Joe Weinman ）受邀出席，并发表主旨演讲——作为长期活跃于全球科技与产业前沿的思想者，乔·韦曼凭借横跨技术研究与商业战略的系统性洞察，持续为 AI 驱动下的产业变革提供前瞻性判断与实践方法论 。 本次活动汇聚了中关村两院师生、 直博生 夏令营营员及北纬 社区科创企业 负责人等各界代表，围绕 AI 时代的产业变革、商业增长与人才培养等核心议题展开深入交流 。 跨越太平洋的访问，感受中关村两院科研创新活力 活动当日，乔 · 韦曼近距离倾听了学院师生分享中关村两 院最新 科研成果，真切感受学院在前沿科技领域的创新与探索、人才培育及成果落地转化方面的 “ 超常规 ” 实践。 现场展示的前沿项目涵盖多个技术领域，包括识别准确率高达 99.9% 的病毒识别系统“ DeepVirus ”，支持跨地域机器人协同学习且可以从人类第一视角视频中学习物理常识 的具身通用 智能模型“ Physbrain ”以及基于智能体模拟人类社会行为的仿真平台等 。 围绕相关项目的技术路线、应用场景与产业化前景，乔·韦曼与现场师生进行了深入交流与探讨。他指出：这些来自不同领域的、激动人心的创新实践，生动诠释了一个重要共识： 在算力与 算法日益趋同的当下，真正驱动科技创新与产业变革的核心稀缺资源，依然是人才、认知能力、原创创造力以及高效的组织协同能力 。 思想对撞 ， 探讨 AI 时代稀缺资源与变革逻辑 参观结束后，乔·韦曼与师生面对面进行了一场深度交流，以“聚焦人工智能时代的稀缺资源与变革要点”为主题，围绕 AI 时代的核心稀缺要素、产业变

On May 22, 2026, the latest North Latitude Nobel Summit Dialogue was grandly held at Zhongguancun College x Zhongguancun AI Research Institute (referred to as "Zhongguancun Two Institutes"), co-hosted by the Zhongguancun Two Institutes and North Latitude Harbor. Renowned global AI strategy expert and founder of the U.S. Future Industries Research Institute, Joe Weinman, was invited to attend and deliver a keynote speech. As a long-active thinker at the forefront of global technology and industry, Joe Weinman leverages his systematic insights spanning technology research and business strategy to continuously provide forward-looking judgments and practical methodologies for AI-driven industrial transformation. The event brought together representatives including faculty and students of the Zhongguancun Two Institutes, participants of the direct PhD summer camp, and leaders of tech startups in the North Latitude community, engaging in in-depth discussions on core topics such as industrial transformation, business growth, and talent cultivation in the AI era. Crossing the Pacific for a visit, experiencing the vitality of research and innovation at the Zhongguancun Two Institutes. On the event day, Joe Weinman listened closely as faculty and students shared the latest research achievements of the Zhongguancun Two Institutes, truly experiencing the institute's "extraordinary" practices in cutting-edge technology innovation and exploration, talent cultivation, and the transformation and application of results. The cutting-edge projects showcased on-site covered multiple technical fields, including the virus identification system "DeepVirus" with an accuracy rate of up to 99.9%, and a system supporting cross-regional robot collaborative learning from human first-person perspectives.

Como pensador activo desde hace mucho tiempo en la vanguardia de la tecnología y la industria global, Joe Weinman, con su visión sistemática que abarca la investigación tecnológica y la estrategia empresarial, continúa impulsando la transformación industrial liderada por la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: What does it cost to fit an AI host capable of running a 122B large model into a pocket? Over the past half year, the logic of on-device AI hardware has been shifting. Two months ago, a phenomenal wave of local deployment of Agents swept across China, with a surge of AI enthusiasts starting to "raise shrimp," unexpectedly propelling the once-niche Mac mini into the spotlight, leading to price premiums and shortages. In more hardcore developer circles, the Nvidia DGX Spark, priced at 30,000 to 40,000 yuan, has also gained significant traction, as it can already run a hundred-billion-parameter model locally. The simultaneous rise of the Mac mini and DGX Spark points to the same trend: Agents are rapidly raising the bar for on-device AI hardware. Previously, AI PCs with 40 TOPS could only handle lightweight tasks like conversation and generation. But in the Agent era, developers are pursuing larger models, longer local inference, and on-device AI devices truly capable of productivity tasks. The problem emerges: the Mac mini is quiet and low-power but struggles to support larger local models; the DGX Spark boasts powerful performance, but its price, power consumption, and heat dissipation make it hard to popularize. It seems difficult to achieve high computing power, low power consumption, and small size all at once. What the Agent era truly lacks is no longer just a more powerful AI PC, but a new terminal that can run 7×24 hours, with low power consumption, quiet operation, and local execution capability—something in between.

En el último año y medio, la lógica del hardware de IA en el dispositivo está cambiando. Hace dos meses, surgió en China una fiebre fenomenal por implementar agentes localmente, con muchos entusiastas de la IA comenzando a "cultivar camarones", lo que hizo que el Mac mini, antes un producto de nicho, se volviera inesperadamente popular, llegando incluso a tener sobreprecio y escasez. Para soportar esta demanda incesante de capacidad computacional, es indispensable una infraestructura de inteligencia artificial fiable. Pero la capacidad computacional es solo la mitad de la historia. "Al final, los escenarios deben realizarse a través de portátiles, teléfonos móviles u otros terminales", comentó un inversor a Leiphone.

items.title: Code Arena放榜：阿里千问3.7编程能力超越GPT、Gemini，仅次于Claude系列

excerpt_i18n.en:
On May 26 early morning, the global authoritative third-party programming ranking Code Arena released its results. Alibaba's latest flagship model Qwen3.7-Max scored 1541, surpassing GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6, and other models, ranking second globally among major model providers, behind only the Claude series. This marks Qwen3.7's successful entry into the top tier of global programming models in code understanding and generation.  

Caption: Code Arena rankings show Alibaba ranks second globally with Qwen3.7-Max.  

Programming capability is a core indicator of current model intelligence levels, and Code Arena is one of the most influential rankings launched by the well-known third-party blind testing platform LMArena. Unlike traditional code benchmarks, Code Arena does not assess isolated code snippet generation or conventional algorithm problems. Instead, developers pose tasks requiring models to generate complete, interactive web applications from scratch, with users anonymously comparing the outputs of two models through pairwise voting. The rankings are compiled from aggregated votes, making Code Arena widely regarded as one of the most credible AI programming capability evaluations globally. Through blind testing based on real user experiences and global developer votes, Qwen3.7's programming capability ranks among the top four, breaking the long-standing dominance of Claude-Opus-4.7 and 4.6 in the top four slots.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 26 de mayo a primera hora, la lista global autorizada de programación de terceros Code Arena publicó sus resultados. El modelo insignia más reciente de Alibaba, Qwen3.7-Max, obtuvo una puntuación de 1541, superando a modelos como GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GLM-5.1 y Kimi-K2.6, solo por detrás de la serie Claude, ocupando el segundo lugar a nivel mundial entre los fabricantes de modelos grandes. Esto también marca que, en el ámbito de la comprensión y generación de código, Qwen 3.7 ha logrado posicionarse con éxito en el primer escalón de los modelos de programación globales.
